dedupe_keys.name: closed loop wind farm controller active power tracking thrust balancing load limiting for sowfa simulations

description: Jean Gonzalez Silva and colleagues publish a MATLAB controller for closed-loop wind-farm simulations with SOWFA. Zenodo provides one public ZIP under CC BY 4.0. The own page describes down-regulation to follow an active-power reference, balancing thrust across turbines and limiting aerodynamic loads on selected machines. MATLAB communicates through ZeroMQ, and the example uses DTU 10 MW turbines in the TotalControl 32-turbine reference layout. The controller can test power and load trade-offs in coordinated wind-farm operation. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this implementation. Coverage is the configured wind-farm layout and SOWFA operating cases, not a live plant control system. A limitation is that the page does not establish the controller tuning range, all supported SOWFA versions or physical field validation. ZeroMQ and SOWFA must be supplied separately. Neither the ZIP nor simulator was downloaded or run, and the stated tracking performance was not independently checked.
